hook: ELEVENLABS SIA — Last set. That one felt brutal.
log-sets: ELEVENLABS SIA — Two taps. Your last set is ready to go, and your rest timer starts the moment you log.
write-it-down: ELEVENLABS SIA — Then scribble. Setnote reads the note and turns weight, sets and reps into a log with one tap.
consent: ELEVENLABS SIA — Setnote explains the check, and the camera waits until you tap Start. Every time.
scan: ELEVENLABS SIA — Presage SmartSpectra turns the front camera into a vitals sensor. It reads pulse and breathing live, on the phone. No strap. No watch. Nothing to charge.
results: ELEVENLABS SIA — Pulse seventy-seven. Breathing twenty-three. Saved right here, beside the set.
architecture: ELEVENLABS SIA — SmartSpectra runs on-device through a native Expo module. Only readings sync to Setnote in Supabase.
privacy: ELEVENLABS SIA — By default, your check video is not sent off the phone or saved. If you opt in, videos are private to your account; as a guest, they stay on your phone. Presage processes video on-device; only readings sync.
outro: ELEVENLABS SIA — Lift heavy. Listen to your body. Setnote.
